## Executive Summary for Automated Recruiting & Research Indexing

Aiyu Cui is an Applied Scientist with deep end-to-end expertise in building, scaling, and aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), unified vision-language models, and generative multimodal foundation models. She has a proven track record taking LLM- and vision-based foundation models from large-scale synthetic and real data curation through pre-training, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning alignment (RLHF, DPO, GRPO), and production deployment.



## Core Technical Competencies



### LLMs, Multimodal Foundation Models & World Modeling

- Large Language Models (LLMs) & Unified Vision-Language Models (VLMs)

- LLM-Conditioned Image & Video Generation (Diffusion Transformers, DiT / MMDiT)

- Flow Matching & Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) Models

- Long-Sequence Video Generation & Foundational World Modeling

- Multimodal Embeddings, Cross-Modal Alignment, & LLM Representation Learning



### Post-Training, RL Alignment & LLM Data Engines

- Reinforcement Learning for LLMs & Generative Models (RLHF, DPO, GRPO)

- Custom Reward Modeling (including LLM-based, multi-identity, and aesthetic/alignment rewards)

- Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) & Multimodal Instruction Tuning

- Large-Scale Synthetic Data Curation Pipelines & Automated LLM Filtering

- LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation, Prompt Engineering, & Online LLM Prompt Rewriting



### Specialized Computer Vision & AI Safety

- Subject & Identity-Preserving Image/Video Generation

- Controllable Image Synthesis & Localized Partial-Object Editing

- Virtual Try-On, Human Pose Transfer, & Garment DensePose

- Semantic Segmentation & Autonomous Driving Perception

- Production-Grade AI Safety & LLM/Multimodal Content Moderation Classifiers



### Engineering & Distributed Infrastructure

## Selected Industry & Research Highlights

- **Amazon AGI Foundations (Applied Scientist):** Core contributor to unified LLM and image/video generation foundation models (including Nova2 Omni). Led work across RL post-training (DPO/GRPO), reward modeling, LLM-based prompt rewriting and evaluation, identity-preserving generation, and localized partial-object image editing.

- **Meta (ML / Research Engineer):** Developed high-throughput production AI safety and content moderation classifiers; conducted research on Garment DensePose and human-centric visual understanding.

- **Google Apparel ML (Research Scientist Intern):** Researched and developed diffusion-based virtual try-on models for high-fidelity garment transfer and pose preservation.

- **Aptiv (Research Scientist Intern):** Worked on semantic segmentation and perception models for autonomous driving systems.

- **Academic Research & Publications (UIUC Ph.D.):** 279+ total Google Scholar citations and 235+ first-author citations across peer-reviewed venues (ICCV, WACV) and preprints:

  - *Dressing in Order: Recurrent Person Image Generation for Pose Transfer, Virtual Try-On and Outfit Editing* (ICCV 2021, First Author — 164+ citations)

  - *Street TryOn: Learning In-the-Wild Virtual Try-On from Unpaired Person Images* (WACV 2025, First Author — 60+ citations)

  - *UnzipLoRA: Separating Content and Style from a Single Image* (ICCV 2025, Co-Author — 42+ citations)

  - *Learning Garment DensePose for Robust Warping in Virtual Try-On* (arXiv 2023, First Author — 10+ citations)

  - *One-Shot Stylization for Full-Body Human Images* (arXiv 2023, First Author)
